slots.title: Bitcoin buyers snap up a brief drop below $80,000 as Asian stocks rebound
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin tore back to $82,500 within two hours of dipping under $80,000, and chipmakers in Seoul recovered from their worst close since April.

slots.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The departure of President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, leaves the digital assets office vacant and its policy aims uncertain.

slots.title: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The new car used thrusters to leap over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Tesla Semi, Model Y, and Model 3 at a demo in Texas.

slots.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

slots.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain
